entities.summary: Aleksey Yefimovich Mazurenko was the commander of the 7th Guards Assault Aviation Regiment in the Black Sea Fleet during World War II. He was twice awarded the title Hero of the Soviet Union during the war and remained in the military afterwards, reaching the rank of General-major.
